subject: Create project structure and package.json
description:
## Task: Set up the project directory structure and package.json

### Context
Read `scripts/slop-score/prompt.md` for full project context.

### What to do
1. Create the directory structure:
```bash
mkdir -p scripts/slop-score/{src/lib,src/__tests__,data,fixtures}
```

2. Create `scripts/slop-score/package.json`:
```json
{
  "name": "slop-score-cli",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "test": "bun test",
    "test:watch": "bun test --watch",
    "build": "./build.sh",
    "dev": "bun src/analyse.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@msgpack/msgpack": "^3.1.2",
    "wink-pos-tagger": "^2.2.2"
  }
}
```

3. Run `cd scripts/slop-score && bun install` to install dependencies

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Directory structure exists: `src/lib`, `src/__tests__`, `data`, `fixtures`
- [ ] `package.json` exists with correct content
- [ ] `bun install` completes successfully
- [ ] `node_modules` directory created with dependencies
